philosophy.title: Design Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: The principles behind every decision I make.

principles.title: Clarity over cleverness
principles.body: Good design should feel obvious — not because it's simple, but because it's well-structured and thoughtfully considered.

principles.title: Solve the right problem first
principles.body: Visual polish matters, but only after layout, hierarchy, and usability are resolved. Every decision should earn its place.

principles.title: Design for how people actually read
principles.body: Users scan, they don't study. Clear hierarchy, predictable layouts, and familiar patterns let people act with confidence and minimal effort.

principles.title: Think in systems, not screens
principles.body: Consistent components, spacing rules, and type scales improve the experience for users and the velocity of the team building it.

principles.title: Iterate toward better
principles.body: Design is a continuous process — sharpened through feedback, iteration, and contact with the real world.

about.title: About Qomardeen Tijani — Product Designer
about.subtitle: Product Designer building scalable, user-centered digital products.
about.p1: I'm a Product Designer focused on building clear, structured, and high-impact digital products across SaaS platforms, internal tools, and consumer-facing experiences. I combine product thinking, UX reasoning, and strong visual execution to design interfaces that help users complete tasks efficiently and with confidence.
about.p2: I approach design as a problem-solving discipline. Before moving into high-fidelity design, I focus on understanding user goals, workflows, constraints, and edge cases — creating solutions that are intuitive, logically organized, and scalable as products grow.
about.p3: My experience spans CMMS platforms, dashboards, fintech products, and website design. I've shipped live digital products end-to-end — from research and discovery through wireframes, visual design, and production handoff — with a strong focus on conversion-focused landing pages and cohesive product flows.
about.p4: Before transitioning fully into product design, I worked in fashion design, where I developed a deep appreciation for balancing aesthetics with structure, constraints, and user expectations. That foundation sharpened my systems thinking and attention to detail, which now directly informs my digital work.
about.p5: I'm actively seeking a product design role where I can contribute immediately, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and continue delivering impactful work.
about.job1Desc: Design onboarding, wallet management, and payment screens for a fintech app — using research, wireframing, and prototyping to simplify complex financial workflows and reduce friction during transactions.
about.job2Desc: Led end-to-end UX/UI design of a CMMS platform — research, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma — plus landing pages and core product architecture across authentication, payments, and support. Worked with project managers and engineers in an Agile team to speed up delivery.
about.job3Desc: Own end-to-end project planning, timelines, and delivery across cross-functional teams — keeping scope, budget, and quality on track. Introduced structured workflows and reporting that improved execution predictability and stakeholder visibility, while coordinating client communication, resourcing, and risk management from kickoff through handover.
about.job4Desc: Led creative direction, production, and client delivery
